# Tailwind

Use this skill for maintainable utility-first styling and responsive composition.

## When to Use This Skill

- Building new layouts and component styles.
- Refactoring style duplication.
- Applying responsive and state-based variants.
- Aligning style choices to design tokens.

## Quick Start

1. Start with layout and spacing utilities.
2. Add semantic typography and color token usage.
3. Validate breakpoint behavior and interaction states.

## Step-by-Step Workflows

### Implement Styles

1. Build mobile-first base styles.
2. Layer responsive and interactive variants.
3. Verify readability and contrast.

### Refactor Styles

1. Remove duplicated utility bundles.
2. Extract reusable patterns into components/classes where needed.
3. Re-test visual parity across breakpoints.

## Gotchas

- Do not hardcode arbitrary colors where tokens are available.
- Do not add unnecessary utility churn without clarity gains.
- Do not ignore focus and disabled states in interactive elements.
